description: Lignes de tramway - Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservice.siglr.org. Tram lines on the territory of Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole - Réseau TAM Avril 2012 (lines 1, 2, 3 and 4). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Tram lines - Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RESEAU, TRAM, TRANSPORTS EN COMMUN, TRANSPORTS, données ouvertes, TRANSPORT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
